title: Pork Ribs
instructions: Mix up spices in a bowl, slather some on top of pork ribs, and wrap them in tin foil.
Bake at 150C for about two hours, then check for doneness.
Once tender, uncover, add the juice to the remainder of the spice mix, and brush on top.
Finish baking at higher temp so it crusts up nicely. Brush the rub on a few times.
Serve with some dip, jalapenos, pickles, mustard, bread, etc.
